crossRefs.note: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also…
For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

translations.web: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
translations.bsb: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
translations.kjv: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope
translations.asv: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee. Psalm 34 A Psalm of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
